# About this programme

<!-- GENERATED by book/tools/make-reference.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->

What this book is teaching, and where that list of calls comes from.

## The 2026 Mainstream program

In 2025 CALLERLAB's members voted to replace the previous Basic, Mainstream and SSD programs with a single **Mainstream Dance Program** of 50 calls and call families. It took effect on **1 September 2026**.

This book follows that program: the 50 teaching units below are the CALLERLAB (New) Mainstream Suggested Teaching Order, and the definitions, timings and styling on every call page are the ones in the *Mainstream Dance Program Definitions*, revised 29 March 2026.

| | |
|---|---|
| Teaching units | 50 |
| Calls (units plus their lettered parts) | 78 |
| Taught with an animation | 75 |
| Taught from the definition alone | 3 |

## The few calls with no animation yet

These are taught in full from the manual; there is simply nothing to watch. [Animations index](animations-index.md) lists them too.

| Unit | Call |
|---|---|
| M4a | Right/Left Arm Turn |
| M14b | Backtrack |
| M32c | Right/Left Hand Trade |

## If you learned before 2026

Some calls you know are no longer in the programme, and some names changed. [Moved and renamed](moved-and-renamed.md) lists both.
